items.title: NASA Science
items.summary: How was the Saturn system imaged so clearly? Astrophotographer Tom Williams captured such exquisite details due to one night of exceptional atmospheric conditions above the United Kingdom. This means more than a cloudless sky. Pockets of air at different temperatures and densities move around and bend light as it travels through Earth’s atmosphere, distorting astronomy images. This is called “seeing”. items.label: Wikipedia discovery
items.title: כפר סבא
items.summary: כְּפַר סָבָא (ההגייה התקנית: כפר סָבָ֫א, ההגייה הרווחת: כפר סַ֫בָּא) היא עיר במחוז המרכז בישראל. היא הוכרזה כעיר ב-1 באפריל 1962. שטחה כ-14 קמ"ר, ובספטמבר 2019 התגוררו בה כ-101,456 תושבים על 37,613 בתי אב. כפר סבא היא מרכז מנהלי ומסחרי, של מוסדות חינוך ושירותי רפואה לאזור דרום השרון, ויש בה מרכז תעשייה גדול.

items.label: From the classics
items.title: Plato — Apology
items.summary: Be of good cheer about death, and know of a certainty, that no evil can happen to a good man, either in life or after death.

items.label: Poem
items.title: יהודה הלוי — שובי נפשי למנוחיכי
items.summary:
שׁוּבִי, נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי
כִּי יְיָ גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי!
יְקָרָה, מִיְּקָר יוֹצְרֵךְ לְקוּחָה,
קוּמִי, כִּי לֹא זֹאת הַמְּנוּחָה!

items.label: Long read
items.title: The ghetto on the lagoon
items.summary: Sixteenth-century Venice wanted to expel its Jews but couldn’t do without them. Its compromise was the world’s first ghetto

items.label: Discovery
items.title: Two Chemists Win Nobel Prize for Unraveling a Mystery of Molecular 'Handedness,' Helping Drugmakers Develop Safer Medications
items.summary: Many molecules come in two mirrored forms—like left and right hands—but living organisms generally contain only one. However, chemists couldn't figure out how to make just one version in the lab. Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai share the prize for their work solving the puzzle
items.image_alt: Two Chemists Win Nobel Prize for Unraveling a Mystery of Molecular 'Handedness,' Helping Drugmakers Develop Safer Medications

items.title: A Ship Carrying Stacks of Ancient Dishware Sank Off the Coast of Turkey 2,100 Years Ago. Its Ceramic Cargo Is Still Remarkably Intact
items.summary: Researchers believe that the vessel's plates and bowls were made in the ancient city of Rhosus, once praised by Roman statesman Cicero for its "fine pottery"
